facts.fact: StartupBeat says Sème City, launched in 2017 with World Bank backing as a campus for research and startup incubation, runs the Next Impact scheme giving 18-35 year olds up to CFA 30 million per project and six months of coaching.
StartupBeat says EtriLabs, a startup incubator, was created in 2009 in Benin; no programme or cohort is described.
